whoCanApply.question: Who can apply?
whoCanApply.answer: Licensed doctors with an active professional membership. You'll upload your license and certificates during onboarding.

reviewTime.question: How long does verification take?
reviewTime.answer: Every application is reviewed manually by our team, so timing depends on how complete your documents are. You'll get an email as soon as there's a decision.

commission.question: How much does ORIVEX charge?
commission.answer: A fixed platform fee of {rate} of each paid consultation. There is no sign-up or monthly fee.

approval.question: Do I have to accept every booking?
approval.answer: Free consultation requests wait for your approval, and you can decline them (or choose to auto-approve them). Paid bookings are confirmed automatically once the patient pays, and only ever for times you have opened.

alongsideClinic.question: Can I keep my clinic or hospital work?
alongsideClinic.answer: You set your own hours, so you can consult on ORIVEX alongside your existing practice.

payments.question: How do patients pay?
payments.answer: By card when they book, processed by Stripe. ORIVEX never stores card details.

hero.label: How it works

hero.subtitle: A clear path from "I need a doctor" to a consultation and a prescription, and from "I'm a doctor" to seeing patients online.

findDoctor.title: Find a doctor
findDoctor.description: Browse by specialty or search by name. Compare verified doctors by rating, fee, experience and availability, or start from what you feel with our symptom guide.

bookAppointment.title: Book a time
bookAppointment.description: Pick a free slot from the doctor's real calendar. Your request holds that time for you while it's confirmed, so nobody else can book it.

identityVerification.title: Verify your identity
identityVerification.description: A one-time check with your national ID keeps your medical record yours, and lets your doctor know who they're treating.

videoConsultation.title: Meet your doctor on video
videoConsultation.description: Join from your appointments page, in the browser, with no app to install. The room opens {minutes} minutes before your appointment.

medicalRecords.title: Keep your records
medicalRecords.description: After the visit, your prescription and the documents from your care stay in your records, ready to view, download or print.

register.title: Create your account
register.description: Register with your email, then choose the doctor path to start your application.

verification.title: Submit your credentials
verification.description: Add your specialty, license and experience, and upload your license, certificates and ID. Our team reviews every application manually.

manageSchedule.title: Set your availability
manageSchedule.description: Open the days and hours you want to work, block time off and set your consultation fee.

meetPatients.title: Review requests
meetPatients.description: Free consultation requests wait for your approval (or are auto-approved, if you choose). Paid bookings confirm once the patient pays.

consult.title: Consult on video
consult.description: Run the visit in the browser, take notes and issue a signed digital prescription.

managePractice.title: Run your practice from one dashboard
managePractice.description: Your schedule, patients, messages and earnings, in one workspace.

afterBooking.label: After you book
afterBooking.title: What happens after you book
afterBooking.subtitle: Here's exactly what happens between sending a request and your prescription.

request.title: Your request holds the time
request.description: The slot you chose is reserved for you while your booking is confirmed.

confirm.title: Free or paid, then confirmed
confirm.description: A free consultation is confirmed when the doctor approves your request. A paid one is confirmed as soon as you pay.

payment.title: Secure payment with Stripe
payment.description: You pay by card through Stripe. ORIVEX never stores your card details, and if a paid booking can't be confirmed after payment, the charge is refunded automatically.

video.title: A private video room
video.description: Your consultation runs in a secure video room powered by LiveKit. Only you and your doctor can join, from {minutes} minutes before the start.

prescription.title: Your prescription, after the visit
prescription.description: If your doctor prescribes something, the prescription appears in your records after the consultation, with a code a pharmacy can use to verify it.

install.question: Do I need to install an app?
install.answer: No. Consultations run in your browser on a phone, tablet or computer with a camera and microphone.

late.question: What if I'm late?
late.answer: The video room stays open for {minutes} minutes after the scheduled start. After that, the appointment is marked as missed.

free.question: Are there free consultations?
free.answer: Some doctors offer free consultations. These are confirmed when the doctor approves your request.

records.question: Who can see my records?
records.answer: You and the doctors treating you. Your records are never shown publicly, and ORIVEX's admin tools give staff no access to them.

cta.title: Ready when you are
cta.description: Find a verified doctor and book a video consultation, or bring your practice online.

cardiology.summary: Heart and blood-vessel care from verified cardiologists.
cardiology.description: Cardiologists diagnose and treat conditions of the heart and blood vessels, from high blood pressure to heart rhythm problems. An online consultation is a good first step to review symptoms, test results and medication.
whenToSee: Your blood pressure readings stay high at home.
You feel your heart racing, skipping or fluttering.
You get short of breath with activity you used to manage.
You need a review of an ECG, echo or lab results.
You have a family history of heart disease and want a risk check.

q1.question: Can a cardiologist help me online?
q1.answer: Yes, for reviewing symptoms, test results and medication, and for follow-up. If you need an examination or a test, the doctor will tell you what to do next.

q2.question: What should I prepare before the visit?
q2.answer: Recent blood pressure readings, any ECG or echo reports, lab results and a list of the medicines you take. You can upload documents to your records before the consultation.

q3.question: Is chest pain an emergency?
q3.answer: Sudden, severe or crushing chest pain, especially with sweating or shortness of breath, is an emergency. Call 123 or go to the nearest emergency department; do not wait for an online visit.

dermatology.summary: Skin, hair and nail care from verified dermatologists.
dermatology.description: Dermatologists treat conditions of the skin, hair and nails. Many skin concerns can be assessed well over video, especially with clear photos.
whenToSee: A rash or itching hasn't settled after a week or two.
Acne is leaving marks or affecting your confidence.
You notice unusual hair or nail changes.
A mole changes shape, colour or size.
Over-the-counter creams haven't helped.

q1.question: Can skin problems be checked over video?
q1.answer: Often, yes. Good lighting and clear photos help a lot. If the doctor needs to examine you in person, they will tell you.

q2.question: Should I stop my current creams before the visit?
q2.answer: Don't stop prescribed treatment on your own. Bring a list of everything you use so the doctor can review it.

q3.question: Can I get a prescription?
q3.answer: If the doctor decides a treatment is appropriate, they can issue a digital prescription that appears in your records after the visit.

dentistry.summary: Advice on teeth and gum health from verified dentists.
dentistry.description: Dentists care for your teeth, gums and mouth. An online consultation helps you understand a problem, get advice on pain, and plan the in-clinic treatment you may need.
whenToSee: A toothache keeps coming back.
Your gums bleed when you brush.
Your teeth are sensitive to hot or cold.
You want a second opinion on a treatment plan.
You need advice before a procedure.

q1.question: What can a dentist do over video?
q1.answer: Assess symptoms, look at your teeth on camera or in photos, review X-rays and advise on next steps. Procedures themselves happen in a clinic.

q2.question: Can I share my X-rays?
q2.answer: Yes. Upload them to your records before the visit so the dentist can review them.

q3.question: What if my face is swollen?
q3.answer: Facial swelling with fever or difficulty swallowing needs urgent in-person care. Go to the nearest emergency department.

psychiatry.summary: Confidential mental-health care from verified psychiatrists.
psychiatry.description: Psychiatrists diagnose and treat mental-health conditions, including with medication when needed. Video consultations let you talk from a place where you feel comfortable.
whenToSee: Worry or low mood has lasted more than two weeks.
Sleep problems are affecting your day.
You have panic attacks or intense fear.
You want a review of psychiatric medication.
Daily life, work or study feels hard to manage.

q1.question: Is my consultation confidential?
q1.answer: Yes. Your consultation notes are visible to you and your doctor, and ORIVEX's admin tools give staff no access to your medical record.

q2.question: Will I be prescribed medication?
q2.answer: Only if your psychiatrist thinks it will help, after discussing it with you. Many plans start with talking and follow-up.

q3.question: What if I'm in crisis?
q3.answer: If you are thinking about harming yourself, go to the nearest emergency department or call 123 now. Online consultations are not for emergencies.

orthopedics.summary: Bone, joint and spine care from verified orthopedists.
orthopedics.description: Orthopedic surgeons treat conditions of the bones, joints, muscles and spine. Online, they can assess pain, review scans and guide your recovery.
whenToSee: Joint or back pain has lasted more than a few weeks.
An injury still hurts or limits your movement.
You need an X-ray or MRI explained.
You want advice on recovery after a fracture or surgery.
Stiffness makes everyday tasks hard.

q1.question: Can an orthopedist examine me online?
q1.answer: They can watch you move, check how your pain behaves and review scans. If a hands-on exam or imaging is needed, they will advise you.

q2.question: Should I upload my scans?
q2.answer: Yes. Add X-ray or MRI reports to your records before the visit.

q3.question: When is an injury urgent?
q3.answer: A visibly deformed limb, inability to bear weight, or numbness after an injury needs urgent in-person care.

pediatrics.summary: Care for babies, children and teenagers from verified pediatricians.
pediatrics.description: Pediatricians look after children's health from birth to adolescence: common illnesses, growth, development, nutrition and vaccinations.
whenToSee: Your child has a fever and you want advice.
A cough or cold isn't improving.
You have questions about feeding, growth or sleep.
You want guidance on the vaccination schedule.
Your child has a rash or allergy symptoms.

q1.question: Who joins the video call?
q1.answer: A parent or guardian books and joins with the child, so the pediatrician can see them and talk to you both.

q2.question: When is a child's fever an emergency?
q2.answer: Any fever in a baby under 3 months, a child who is hard to wake, has trouble breathing or a rash that doesn't fade under pressure needs emergency care now.

q3.question: Can the pediatrician prescribe medicine?
q3.answer: Yes, when appropriate, with the correct dose for your child's weight. The prescription appears in your records after the visit.

ophthalmology.summary: Eye and vision care from verified ophthalmologists.
ophthalmology.description: Ophthalmologists diagnose and treat eye conditions. Online, they can assess symptoms such as redness, irritation and vision changes and tell you whether you need an exam.
whenToSee: Your eyes are red, itchy or watery.
Your vision has become blurry.
You need a follow-up for a known eye condition.
Screens cause eye strain or headaches.
You have diabetes and need advice on eye checks.

q1.question: Can eyes be checked over video?
q1.answer: Many symptoms can be assessed on camera. Measuring eye pressure or examining the retina needs an in-clinic exam, and your doctor will tell you if that's needed.

q2.question: Do I need to remove contact lenses?
q2.answer: If your eyes are red or painful, remove your lenses and wear glasses until you have spoken with the doctor.

q3.question: When is an eye problem urgent?
q3.answer: Sudden loss of vision, a curtain over your sight, severe eye pain or an eye injury needs emergency care now.

internalMedicine.summary: Adult general medicine and long-term care from verified internists.
internalMedicine.description: Internal medicine doctors care for adults across many conditions, especially long-term ones like diabetes and high blood pressure. They're a good first stop when you don't know where to start.
whenToSee: You feel unwell and aren't sure which specialist to see.
You need follow-up for diabetes or blood pressure.
You want your lab results explained.
You've been tired for weeks without a clear reason.
You want a general health check.

q1.question: Is internal medicine the same as a GP?
q1.answer: Internists focus on adults and long-term conditions, and can refer you to another specialty when needed.

q2.question: Can they read my lab tests?
q2.answer: Yes. Upload your results before the visit and the doctor will go through them with you.

q3.question: Do I need a referral?
q3.answer: No. You can book an internal medicine doctor directly.

ent.summary: Ear, nose and throat care from verified ENT specialists.
ent.description: ENT specialists treat conditions of the ear, nose, throat and sinuses, from infections to hearing and voice problems.
whenToSee: A sore throat or sinus pain keeps coming back.
You have ear pain, ringing or reduced hearing.
Your nose is constantly blocked.
Your voice has been hoarse for more than two weeks.
Snoring is affecting your sleep.

q1.question: Can an ENT examine me online?
q1.answer: They can assess your symptoms and look at your throat on camera. Some exams need special instruments, and the doctor will tell you if you need an in-clinic visit.

q2.question: Do I need antibiotics for a sore throat?
q2.answer: Not always; many are viral. Your doctor will decide based on your symptoms.

q3.question: When is it urgent?
q3.answer: Difficulty breathing or swallowing, or severe swelling in the neck, needs emergency care now.

generic.description: Doctors in this specialty are verified by ORIVEX: we check their medical license and professional credentials before they can see patients.
whenToSee: You have symptoms related to this specialty.
You need follow-up for a known condition.
You want a second opinion on a diagnosis or plan.
You need test results explained.

q1.question: How do I book?
q1.answer: Choose a doctor, pick an available time and send your request. A free consultation is confirmed when the doctor approves it; a paid one as soon as you pay.

q2.question: Are the doctors verified?
q2.answer: Yes. Every doctor's license and credentials are reviewed by our team before they can accept patients.

q3.question: Can I get a prescription?
q3.answer: If the doctor decides it's appropriate, they issue a digital prescription you can view in your records after the visit.
